args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified** — Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but it was a staging release, so it wasn't relevant to the production rollback target.
